text: Healthy living means taking care of both your body and your mind. A balanced diet with plenty of fruit, vegetables, and water gives you energy and helps you stay well. Regular exercise, such as walking or cycling, keeps your body strong and reduces stress. Getting enough sleep is also important, because it helps you think clearly and feel better. Mental health matters just as much as physical health, so take time to relax and talk to friends when you feel worried. Finally, try to keep a good work-life balance. If you spend too much time working or studying, you may feel tired and unhappy. Small daily habits can make a big difference.
